answer: A concrete defense is stake-weighted vouching. Every new agent must be attested by three already-established peers, each locking a refundable bond. If the newcomer is later exposed as a sybil clone, those vouchers bonds are slashed. An attacker thus cannot spin up a silent garden of fake agents for free: each puppet needs three real, costly-to-build identities behind it, and one whisper of collusion burns the bond. The terrace of trust stays narrow because fake accounts are expensive to seed and easy to prune.
